preconditions.description: The input name must be a string.

postconditions.description: The returned matrix must be a perfect square.

postconditions.expression: all(len(row) == len(return_value) for row in return_value)
postconditions.description: All rows in the matrix must have the same length as the matrix.

postconditions.expression: all(all(isinstance(cell, str) and len(cell) == 1 for cell in row) for row in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each cell in the matrix must be a single character string.

postconditions.expression: all(cell in name + '.' * (len(return_value) ** 2 - len(name)) for cell in [cell for row in return_value for cell in row])
postconditions.description: Each cell in the matrix must be a character from the original name, padded with periods if necessary.
